about: The forms of a function name, as the library's article on functions as linguistic expressions states them, each tried in the library at the commit read. A form is tried with the example the article gives and the answer it promises; what the library printed, or the error it raised, is kept beside the promise. The probe of how many files use each form is an outside assessment's reading of 2026-10-07.

forms.reads_en: a verb acting on the object, like an imperative: RemoveAll("x")
forms.reads_fr: un verbe qui agit sur l'objet, comme un impératif : RemoveAll("x")

forms.reads_en: the past participle, the state wanted: Removed("x"), and the original is left alone
forms.reads_fr: le participe passé, l'état voulu : Removed("x"), et l'original est laissé tel quel

forms.reads_en: each verb hands the object back, so the sentence goes on: RemoveQ, ReplaceQ
forms.reads_fr: chaque verbe rend l'objet, si bien que la phrase continue : RemoveQ, ReplaceQ

tries.code:
? Q("texxaxs").
	RemoveQ("x").
	ReplaceQ("e", :With = AHeart()).
	UppercaseQ().
	Spacified()

forms.reads_en: QC chains over a copy and the original stays as it was
forms.reads_fr: QC enchaîne sur une copie et l'original reste tel qu'il était

tries.code:
o1 = new stzString("texxaxs")
? o1.RemoveQC("x").
	ReplaceQ("e", :With = AHeart()).
	UppercaseQ().
	Spacified()
? o1.Content()

forms.reads_en: an @ verb acts on the part the chain took out: @("x").@Removed()
forms.reads_fr: un verbe en @ agit sur la partie que la chaîne a prise : @("x").@Removed()

forms.reads_en: Many takes a list and the verb is done for each: RemoveMany
forms.reads_fr: Many prend une liste et le verbe est fait pour chacun : RemoveMany

forms.reads_en: Except says what to spare: RemoveNonLettersExcept("_")
forms.reads_fr: Except dit ce qu'il faut épargner : RemoveNonLettersExcept("_")

forms.reads_en: the negation is a word of the name: IsNotLetter, IsNotALetter
forms.reads_fr: la négation est un mot du nom : IsNotLetter, IsNotALetter

forms.reads_en: more than one name for the way a person says it, and the words of a name may swap
forms.reads_fr: plus d'un nom pour la façon dont une personne le dit, et les mots d'un nom peuvent s'intervertir

forms.reads_en: the argument says what it is: :With, :StartingAt
W, a condition inside the argument
viz shows the verb's answer on the string
forms.reads_fr: viz montre la réponse du verbe sur la chaîne

forms.reads_en: CS, ST, Z, ZZ: the name says which arguments, in which order
forms.reads_fr: CS, ST, Z, ZZ : le nom dit quels arguments, dans quel ordre

tries.code:
str = new stzString("SOOooooFFfffTANNnnnZA")
str.RemoveManyCS([ "o", "f", "n" ], FALSE)
? str.Content()

forms.reads_en: Q lifts, @@ reads, Qh keeps the history of a chain
forms.reads_fr: Q élève, @@ lit, Qh garde l'historique d'une chaîne

tries.code:
? @@( Qh(12500).
	AddQ(500).
	RetrieveQ(1500).
	DivideByQ(500).
	MultiplyByQ(2).
	History() )

forms.reads_en: F defers an action, FF runs everything deferred before it
forms.reads_fr: F diffère une action, FF exécute tout ce qui était différé avant elle
